column1: # Which core/tests/*.rs file runs in which CI shard: platform (macos, windows, debug), shard, core/<test file>, tab-separated.
# Read and checked by scripts/ci-shard.sh. Only files that leave a platform's last shard (macos `rest`, windows and debug `2`)
# are listed: every other file, a new one included, runs in the last shard. The split only balances time (the seconds are
# one main run of 2026-11-22); any split runs every file once.
# macos share, about 465 s; rest about 490 s; the cli package's job about 560 s.
